talents.name: Improved Tracking

ranks.description: While tracking Beasts, Demons, Dragonkin, Elementals, Giants, Humanoids, or Undead, all damage you deal to the tracked creature type is increased by 1%.

talents.iconHint: Icon not visible in screenshot; tooltip-only crop
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Replaces/supplements Classic Monster Slaying / Humanoid Slaying style tracking bonuses.

talents.name: Deflection
talents.iconHint: Gauntleted hand holding a curved silver parrying blade; green border; rank badge 0
talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was 1% Parry; Forever rank-1 preview shows 2%. Tree label partial 'ival' confirms Survival.

talents.name: Entrapment

ranks.description: When your traps are triggered, all affected targets are Entrapped, preventing them from moving for 1 sec.

talents.iconHint: Dark circular net / spiked trap pattern; greyed at 0
talents.diffNotes: Classic was a % chance on Immolation/Frost/Explosive Trap to root for 5 sec; Forever roots all affected targets for 1 sec when traps trigger. Shot shows leftmost icon in a 4-icon row under Survival header.

talents.name: Savage Strikes

ranks.description: Increases the critical strike chance of all your melee abilities by 2%.

talents.iconHint: Silhouette of snarling wolf/beast head in dark purple/black; green border; rank badge 0
talents.diffNotes: Classic was +10% crit on Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite only; Forever is +2% crit on all melee abilities.

talents.name: Survivalist
talents.iconHint: Silver straight sword angled upper-right on dark blue with light streaks; green border; rank badge 0
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 (+2% health); minor wording ('your total Health' vs 'total health'). Icon appears different from Classic spell_shadow_twilight.

talents.name: Improved Wing Clip

ranks.description: Gives your Wing Clip ability a 7% chance to immobilize the target for 5 sec.

talents.iconHint: Dark metallic armored gauntlet / clawed hand
talents.diffNotes: Classic maxRank 5 at 4/8/12/16/20%; Forever maxRank 3 with rank-1 preview at 7%.

talents.name: Clever Traps

ranks.description: Increases the duration of Freezing and Frost trap effects by 15% and the damage of Immolation and Explosive trap effects by 15%.

talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic rank 1 text and maxRank 2.

talents.name: Surefooted

ranks.description: Increases your hit chance by 1% and reduces the duration of movement impairing effects on you by 10%.

talents.iconHint: Purple-hued wolf/beast howling profile; green border; rank badge 0
talents.diffNotes: Classic added resist chance vs movement impairing (+5% per rank); Forever reduces duration of movement impairing effects on you (10% at rank 1).

talents.name: Deterrence

ranks.description: When activated, increases your Dodge and Parry chance by 25% for 10 sec.

talents.iconHint: Curved circular blade/defensive flourish; greyed at 0
talents.diffNotes: Matches Classic effect text. Tooltip also shows Instant and 5 min cooldown.

talents.name: Counterattack

ranks.description: A strike that becomes active after parrying an opponent's attack. This attack deals 50% weapon damage plus 13 and immobilizes the target for 5 sec. Counterattack cannot be blocked, dodged, or parried.

talents.iconHint: Slanted silver sword on dark blue; green border; rank badge 0
talents.diffNotes: Classic dealt flat 40 damage; Forever is 50% weapon damage + 13. Tooltip also shows 30 Mana, Melee Range, Instant, 5 sec cooldown.

talents.name: Predator's Edge

ranks.description: Increases your melee critical strike damage by 6% and your offhand weapon damage by 10%.

talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Survival tree aesthetic (green forest).

talents.name: Survival Tactics

ranks.description: Increases your chance to hit with your Trap and Feign Death abilities by 5%.

talents.iconHint: Circular mechanical trap-like object; leftmost column in crop
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Conceptually overlaps Classic Trap Mastery / Improved Feign Death but different name and combined hit bonus.

talents.name: Resourcefulness

ranks.description: Reduces the mana cost of your Trap abilities and melee abilities by 30%. In addition, your critical strikes have a 30% chance to allow 50% of your Mana regeneration to continue while casting for 30 sec.

talents.iconHint: Icon obscured by tooltip; Survival green forest background

talents.name: Expose Prey

ranks.description: Your attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark have a 5% chance to activate your Mongoose Bite for 5 sec.

talents.iconHint: Faint greyed creature-head or strike artwork
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match (not Expose Weakness).

talents.name: Survivalist's Discipline

ranks.description: Reduces the cooldown of your Trap and Deterrence abilities by 20%.

talents.iconHint: Hooded figure silhouette; greyed at 0; vertical prerequisite arrow from talent above

talents.iconHint: Partial dark hoofed/clawed leg icon; greyed at 0
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Tooltip shows 61 Mana, Melee Range, Instant, 8 sec cooldown. Background split teal/orange (Survival/MM border) but tree not labeled.

talents.name: Lightning Reflexes

talents.diffNotes: Classic rank 1 was +3% Agility; Forever rank-1 preview shows +2%.

talents.iconHint: Curved blade / claw slash mark; greyed; downward arrow from talent above (boot/armor icon)
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Capstone-style dependency from talent above.

ranks.description: A steady snipe that increases ranged damage by 160.

talents.iconHint: Dark circular silhouette; partially cursor-obscured; prerequisite line from above
talents.diffNotes: No Classic name match. Similar pattern to Classic Aimed Shot (id 1345, +70 ranged damage) but renamed/reworked; tooltip shows 365 Mana, 8-35 yd, 4 sec cast, 15 sec cooldown.
